info.name: Users Service
info.description:
End-to-end API collection for the user-service (FastAPI resource server on AWS Lambda + DynamoDB).

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:8080` | Local app base URL. Set to the deployed API Gateway URL (e.g. `https://<api-id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com`) when testing a deployed environment. |
| `stage` | `local` | Deployment stage; the SSM secret and DynamoDB tables are stage-prefixed. |
| `appName` | `user-service` | Application name; combined with `stage` to form the JWT audience. |
| `audience` | `local-user-service` | Expected JWT audience (`{stage}-{appName}`). Tokens are minted with this audience by the collection pre-request script. |
| `jwtSecret` | `jwt-secret` | HS256 signing secret. Must match the SSM secret seeded by `scripts/init_localstack.py` (`/local/secrets/jwt-secret`) and, in production, the shared auth-service secret. |
| `rootToken` | *(empty)* | Admin token carrying the seeded `root` role — minted automatically before every request. |
| `readerToken` | *(empty)* | Token with only the `users:read roles:read` scope — minted automatically. |
| `expiredToken` | *(empty)* | Token whose `exp` is in the past — minted automatically. |
| `wrongAudienceToken` | *(empty)* | Token signed for `dev-user-service` — minted automatically. |
| `wrongSignatureToken` | *(empty)* | Token signed with a different secret — minted automatically. |
| `unknownRoleToken` | *(empty)* | Token whose only role cannot be resolved to permissions — minted automatically. |
| `userId` | *(empty)* | Latest created user id — set automatically from the `Location` header. |
| `roleId` | *(empty)* | Latest created role id — set automatically from the `Location` header. |
| `usersNextKey` | *(empty)* | Pagination cursor for the users listing. |
| `rolesNextKey` | *(empty)* | Pagination cursor for the roles listing. |

## Notes

- The user-service is a **resource server**: it never issues tokens. The collection pre-request script therefore mints HS256 JWTs locally (CryptoJS) against the shared `jwtSecret`.
- All endpoints under `/api/v1` require a `Bearer` access token with the permissions granted via the token `scope` and/or role resolution (`POST /health` does not).
- The admin (`root`) token resolves its permissions through the seeded `root` role row in the `{stage}-roles` table, exercising role-inheritance resolution on every request.
- Response bodies are camelCase (e.g. `displayName`, `createdAt`, `nextKey`).

request.description: Requests without an Authorization header are rejected immediately with 403.
Non-JWT bearer credentials must fail token decoding with a 403.
Only the Bearer scheme is accepted; Basic credentials are rejected with 403.
Tokens signed with a different secret must fail signature verification with a 403.
Expired tokens must be rejected with a 403.
Tokens minted for another audience (e.g. dev-user-service) must be rejected with a 403.
Write endpoints require users:write; a read-only token must fail with 403 Insufficient permissions.
Role creation requires roles:write; a read-only token must fail with 403 Insufficient permissions.
A role that resolves to no permissions grants nothing; the request must fail with 403 Insufficient permissions.
Scope-based authorization also unlocks read access without any role row.

exec: // The user-service is a resource server: it never issues tokens itself.
// Mint the HS256 JWTs used across the collection against the shared
// secret (the SSM parameter seeded by scripts/init_localstack.py).
// Wrapped in an IIFE: Newman reuses one sandbox for collection-level
// scripts, so top-level const declarations would collide on reruns.
// Root role: resolved to permissions through the seeded root role row.
// Read-only scope token: no role claim at all.
// Expired token (exp is five minutes in the past).
sub: 'expired-user', exp: nowSec - 300, iat: nowSec - 3600, user: { roles: ['root'] }
// Token minted for another stage's audience.
// Token signed with a different secret.
// Token whose role resolves to no permissions.
